page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable markdown blocks. Attach them to agents — the order decides where each block lands in the prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

card.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? This also deletes its version history and detaches it from every agent. This cannot be undone.

config.title: Configuration
config.descriptionPlaceholder: What this skill makes the reviewer do.
config.typeHint: Pick a type or type a new one — it joins the list when you save.
config.bodyHint: Appended to the agent’s prompt as one block. Saving a changed body creates a new version.

versions.title: Versions
versions.hint: Every change to the body is snapshotted. Restoring discards newer versions.
versions.label: Version {version}
versions.initial: Initial version — nothing to compare against.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore version {version}? Every newer version will be permanently deleted.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Pick a Markdown file. Its text becomes the skill body — nothing in it is executed.
import.notMarkdown: That is not a Markdown file. Pick a .md or .markdown file.
import.previewHint: Nothing is saved until you confirm.
